startingCard.title: Russo-Ukrainian war begins
startingCard.subtitle: Conflict
startingCard.fact: The Russo-Ukrainian war began in February 2014 and is ongoing.

cards.title: ‘Anne with an E’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: Canadian drama television series
cards.fact: Anne with an E is a Canadian period drama television series loosely adapted from Lucy Maud Montgomery's 1908 classic work of children's literature, Anne of Green Gables.

cards.title: Gupta Empire is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Gupta Empire was an Indian empire during the classical period of the Indian subcontinent which existed from the mid 3rd century to mid 6th century CE.

cards.title: Hirohito becomes Emperor of Japan
cards.fact: Emperor Shōwa, known colloquially by his personal name Hirohito, was the 124th emperor of Japan according to the traditional order of succession, reigning from 1926 until his death in 1989.

cards.title: Ernst Haeckel dies
cards.subtitle: German zoologist
cards.fact: Ernst Heinrich Philipp August Haeckel was a German zoologist, naturalist, eugenicist, philosopher, physician, professor, marine biologist and artist.

cards.title: Balkan Wars begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Balkan Wars were two conflicts that took place in the Balkan states in 1912 and 1913.

cards.title: ‘On Every Street’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Dire Straits
cards.fact: On Every Street is the sixth and final studio album by British rock band Dire Straits, released on 9 September 1991 by Vertigo Records internationally, and by Warner Bros.

cards.title: Aura is completed
cards.subtitle: Mixed-use skyscraper in Toronto, Ontario, Canada
cards.fact: Aura is a mixed-use skyscraper completed in 2014 in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

cards.title: Korean War begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Korean War was an armed conflict on the Korean Peninsula fought between North Korea and South Korea and their allies.

cards.title: ‘Pericles, Prince of Tyre’ premieres
cards.subtitle: Play by William Shakespeare
cards.fact: Pericles, Prince of Tyre is a Jacobean play written at least in part by William Shakespeare and included in modern editions of his collected works despite questions over its authorship, as it was not included in the First Folio.

cards.title: New York Yankees is founded
cards.subtitle: MLB franchise
cards.fact: The New York Yankees are an American professional baseball team based in the New York City borough of the Bronx.

cards.title: Pompeii is completed
cards.subtitle: Ancient Roman city near modern Naples, Italy
cards.fact: Pompeii was a city in what is now the municipality of Pompei, near Naples, in the Campania region of Italy.

cards.title: Elizabeth I of England becomes queen of England
cards.fact: Elizabeth I was Queen of England and Ireland from 17 November 1558 until her death in 1603.

cards.title: ‘Ænima’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Tool
cards.fact: Ænima is the second studio album by the American rock band Tool.

cards.title: ‘Saint Seiya’ begins
cards.subtitle: Japanese manga series
cards.fact: Saint Seiya, also known as Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac or simply Knights of the Zodiac, is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Masami Kurumada.

cards.title: Battle of Rocroi takes place
cards.subtitle: Battle in Thirty Years' War
cards.fact: The Battle of Rocroi, fought on 19 May 1643, was a major engagement of the Thirty Years' War between a French army, led by the 21-year-old Duke of Enghien and Spanish forces under General Francisco de Melo only five days after the accession of Louis XIV to the throne of France after his father's death.

cards.title: Boeing E-7 Wedgetail first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Boeing
cards.fact: The Boeing E-7 Wedgetail, also marketed as the Boeing 737 AEW&C, is a twin-engine airborne early warning and control aircraft originally designed for the Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF).

cards.title: Emperor Guangwu of Han becomes Emperor of China
cards.fact: Emperor Guangwu of Han, personal name Liu Xiu (劉秀), courtesy name Wenshu (文叔), was the founding emperor of the Chinese Eastern Han dynasty.

cards.title: British Somaliland is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: British Somaliland, officially the Somaliland Protectorate, was a protectorate of the United Kingdom in the territory of modern Somaliland.

cards.title: Anthony Albanese becomes prime minister of Australia
cards.fact: Anthony Norman Albanese is an Australian politician who has served as the 31st prime minister of Australia since 2022.

cards.title: West Ham United F.C. is founded
cards.subtitle: Football club
cards.fact: West Ham United Football Club is a professional football club based in Stratford, East London, England.

cards.title: Gabriel Bethlen becomes Apostolic King of Hungary
cards.fact: Gabriel Bethlen was Prince of Transylvania from 1613 to 1629 and Duke of Opole from 1622 to 1625.

cards.title: ‘Back to the Future Part III’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Robert Zemeckis
cards.fact: Back to the Future Part III is a 1990 American science fiction Western film and the third installment of the Back to the Future trilogy.

cards.title: ‘Evil Empire’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Rage Against the Machine
cards.fact: Evil Empire is the second studio album by the American rock band Rage Against the Machine, released on April 16, 1996, by Epic Records.

cards.title: ‘The Big Lebowski’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Joel Coen
cards.fact: The Big Lebowski is a 1998 crime comedy film written, directed, produced and co-edited by Joel and Ethan Coen, and starring Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Julianne Moore, Steve Buscemi and John Turturro.

cards.title: ‘Escape from Monkey Island’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Lucasfilm Games
cards.fact: Escape from Monkey Island is a 2000 adventure game developed and published by LucasArts.

cards.title: Indiana Pacers is founded
cards.subtitle: NBA franchise
cards.fact: The Indiana Pacers are an American professional basketball team based in Indianapolis.

cards.title: ‘Echo and Narcissus’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by John William Waterhouse
cards.fact: Echo and Narcissus is a 1903 oil painting by John William Waterhouse.

cards.title: Second Boer War begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Second Boer War, also known as the Boer War, Transvaal War, Anglo–Boer War, or the South African War, was a conflict fought between the British Empire and the Boer republics over Britain's influence in Southern Africa.

cards.title: ‘Terminator 2: Judgment Day’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by James Cameron
cards.fact: Terminator 2: Judgment Day is a 1991 American science fiction action film directed by James Cameron, who co-wrote the script with William Wisher.

cards.title: Ishak Pasha Palace is completed
cards.subtitle: Palace in Turkey
cards.fact: Ishak Pasha Palace is a semi-ruined palace and administrative complex located in the Doğubeyazıt district of Ağrı province of eastern Turkey.
